messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Auth service SSO heartbeat anomaly detected — spike in 4xx/5xx from edge cluster eu-west-1. Paging @sre-oncall.

sre-oncall: I'm on it. Acknowledge pager. Can someone post a quick impact summary (errors/sec, customers)?

alice: Seen ~20% increase in 401s for /v1/sso/callback starting 12:02 UTC. Src IPs clustered: 34.72.11.9, 34.72.11.10, 52.14.23.100.

maria: Seeing token validation failures in the logs: `token_validation_failed: signature_mismatch`. Appears to be JWT signature issues from some clients.

sec-eng-evan: Adding security. Any recent key rotations or KMS ops? Could be a mismatch between signer and verifier.

ops-bot: Deploy note: release/edge-proxy canary rolled at 11:55 UTC. No automatic rollback.

sre-oncall: Temporarily applied WAF block for 52.14.23.100/29 (rule id 7c2) and rate-limited /v1/sso/* to 20r/s. Monitoring impact.

alice: Quick logs snippet: 
```json
{"ts":"2026-03-18T12:02:14Z","path":"/v1/sso/callback","status":401,"err":"sig_mismatch","src":"52.14.23.100"}
```

sec-eng-evan: Do we have signs of credential exfiltration or is this malformed JWTs/replay? If key mismatch, we should rotate signing keys for affected proxies asap.

sre-oncall: No confirmed exfil so far — access patterns look like probing/replay from same IP range. Decision: rotate edge signing key pair, update proxy config, and roll canaries. Maria, can you open the rotation playbook ticket and notify support?

maria: Opening ticket INC-8421. Added runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/sso-key-rotation. Notifying Support to prepare customer comms.

alice: Customer-visible failures: roughly 12 integrations impacted, support tickets +8 since spike.

legal-bot: If any customer data is exposed, escalate to Legal. So far, no PII seen in the extracted log snippets.

sre-oncall: Action plan: 1) WAF block + rate-limit (done) 2) rotate signing key on edge proxies (starting) 3) monitor for error regression, rollback if needed 4) prepare customer messaging via INC-8421 (Support + Legal). @sec-eng-evan owns key rotation.

sec-eng-evan: On it — generating new KMS key pair, will coordinate with eng-runtime for signer rollout. ETA ~25m. Logging steps in INC-8421.

maria: Drafted customer notification in ticket, support standing by.

sre-oncall: I'll keep this channel updated with metrics. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
